questions: Which maps and scripts call CBaseAnimating::SetWind, and what ranges do they author?

findings.fact: CBaseAnimating::SetWind and RemoveWind own a source entity plus angle, changes per second, minimum speed and maximum speed.
findings.evidence: 0x1008e480 and 0x1008e630 write server entity +0x63c, +0x640, +0x644, +0x648 and +0x64c; matching send/recv field names identify the four floats.
findings.consequence: Wind is entity state replicated to the client cloth draw path, not a global renderer constant.

functions.label: cbaseanimating_set_wind
functions.role: Sets source, angle, change rate, minimum speed and maximum speed on an animating entity.

functions.label: cbaseanimating_remove_wind
functions.role: Clears the animating entity's wind source/state.
